about: Gates 177 and 178 (gates/drive/layout.js, TC-R248a..f) render sampled screen states at 8 phones (375x761, 390x844, 414x896, 430x932 with his insets; 320x568, 360x640, 375x667, 375x730 without) each at 4 text sizes (50, 75, 100, 125 percent, as the viewport the page zoom gives), and read overlap, text cut, spill, sideways scroll, the board's side gaps and a card's side gaps; a finding that is not on gates/fixtures/177-layout-pins.json is red. Graded here on five of its states (Home, the Review list, Review at move 10, a puzzle with its hint, a lesson at its demo end) on a trial bundle: the real code passes with the remaining faults pinned, and four new faults - each of a different kind - are caught. The fourth (the Analyze chip drawn 120x70 over the move text) checks the ink reading of part 3: a control with no fill of its own is read by what it draws, so its 44px tap box over the text is not a finding and its drawing over the text is. The board half has its own pair (short-upright-boards-sized-to-height-2026-11-12). NOT COVERED: the other states (run by the gates, not by this pair); a fault of a pinned kind on a pinned element in a pinned cell; the Review list's faults at the normal text size (pinned, job 13); Play on the short phones (pinned, his answer awaited); the faults at 50, 75 and 125 percent (pinned: his pick, no more on the zoom axis); his phone's fonts.

breaks.name: the-vs-sits-on-the-name
breaks.why: on the game card the word vs is pulled 22px left, onto the end of the opponent's name: text on text

breaks.name: the-board-leaves-a-side-gap
breaks.why: the board is pushed 16px in from the left edge on every board screen, so it no longer fills the width where it does today

breaks.name: home-scrolls-sideways
breaks.why: Home's first card is made wider than the screen, so Home scrolls sideways and the card runs off the right edge

breaks.name: the-analyze-chip-drawn-over-the-moves
breaks.why: the lesson's Analyze chip is drawn 120 wide and 70 tall, down over the move list: a control's own drawing on top of text
